props.name: children
props.comment: The one field (or input) to label.

props.name: htmlFor
props.comment: Makes the label a `<label>` for the control with this id.

props.name: label
props.comment: Overrides the child's `label`; `false` renders no label.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Overrides the child's `resource` when resolving the label.

props.name: source
props.comment: Overrides the child's `source` when resolving the label.
